description: Protective and ornamental metalwork fixed to a binding: corner pieces, raised bosses, edge shoes, centres, and full plaques. Flat smooth pieces guard shelved volumes, while raised bosses suit books that rest on lecterns; the metal may be enamelled, jewelled, embossed, or chased.
name: metal furniture

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter XVIII, p.262. Internet Archive.
